observations: Original SNL118: each lever contains M355A and M355B and four3/8x1⅜ button-head rivets. Two complete levers require four members/eight rivets.
Original SNL274: two MX78A washers with11/16 bore and two MX78B with13/16 bore. Widths and outside diameters are unprinted.
HB151/154: screw pinned to short band, lever to long band and rear control rod; spring compresses between lever and screw shoulder. Free-end pins require cotters.
M356 quantity4 is explicit; no pin or its cotter dimensions recovered.

Original SNL137 reviewed: four M356 pins; its separately printed M363 anchor cotter is not the free-end cotter specification. Original SNL253 composition confirms adjustment quantities and washer IDs.
SNL Plate 30 (p302) repeats the HB100/HB133 illustration; it is not independent evidence for the hidden lever section.
decisions: Two touching half-width lever members with a split screw channel, joined by four source-sized rivets. Separate definitions retain left/right identities. Axial section is inferred.
Use source-led curved lever outline with retained B-spline control points, not a polygonal display mesh. Fork/pivot envelopes retain the preceding estimates.
MX78B is placed on the larger lower screw guide and MX78A below the lever around the smaller shank; spring seats on these washers. Assignment is an interpretation.
Nut turning bar, shoulders, ground spring ends and thread envelopes are estimates. No helical threads or load qualification.
Retain the existing HB133 image registration. New picks supplement the fixed diagnostic; they do not refit a camera.

Retain flat paired members through a rectangular integral screw saddle. The illustration does not establish a circular barrel; hidden saddle section remains estimated. Preserve the circular trial and its elevated curve-intersection kernel tolerance as a rejected construction.
